format: TypeScript (eslint configuration with Vue.js and Vitest plugins)
description: This file defines ESLint configuration settings for a Vue.js project using TypeScript, Vitest for testing, and Prettier for formatting. It imports configurations from various ESLint plugins and applies them to specific file patterns and ignores. The configuration is exported via defineConfigWithVueTs.

methods.name: defineConfigWithVueTs
methods.description: Function to define ESLint configuration with Vue and TypeScript support.
